dialogues.speaker: Icayo
dialogues.text: C'mon, what's got you so down? Something bad happen? Don't worry — if nothing else, you've got me.

dialogues.speaker: Icayo
dialogues.text: I can't solve your problems, but I'll be by your side no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Icayo
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, have you gotten a little chubby lately?

dialogues.speaker: Icayo
dialogues.text: *sigh* Nah, it's fine — in fact, you look pretty cute now. Want some more Sour Sauce Ceviche?

dialogues.speaker: Icayo
dialogues.text: ...Alright, alright, I know, I missed you too. Didn't expect all of you to show up at once, of course — but I suppose that's what they call "triple the happiness"?
